greeting: Prism Gate Captain on comms. Stage 1: The City of Glass. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Shattered Light. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A map sneezed in my pocket and revealed a hidden staircase. True story.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Pass the Truth Gate.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Pass the Truth Gate; Navigate the Transparent Districts; Gain audience with the Regent. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Enter Prism and navigate its transparent architecture. Immediate move: Pass the Truth Gate.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The City of Glass. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Regent's Revelation.
rumor: A shattered lens was heard chanting the same warning in seven languages.
People keep repeating one clue from The City of Glass: 'Gain audience with the Regent'.
The floor attempted a mutiny at dawn. We resolved it with better boots.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn light in Prism reveals hidden seams in mirrored stone.
dialog.time_noon: Noon overcharges reflection grids. Angle your approach, do not rush centerline.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk doubles your silhouette count. Track teammate positions verbally.
dialog.time_night: Night turns crystal caverns into echo mazes. Keep line-of-sight discipline.

party_reactions.kade: Prism Gate Captain sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Prism Gate Captain accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Prism Gate Captain talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
